text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you please describe the duration of your fatigue and weight loss, and mention any other symptoms you may be experiencing, such as fever, night sweats, or changes in bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned maintaining a good appetite despite significant weight loss; do you experience any abdominal pain, early satiety, or changes in stool consistency or color?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of diabetes, and have you noticed any changes in your urine output or thirst? I also need to know if you have had any recent travels or exposure to infections.

speaker: Doctor
